capabilities: pull RSS feeds into vault notes
template note titles and bodies with Mustache
define custom feed types for extra RSS fields
pull feeds automatically on an interval
route new notes into configurable folders
extras: The README mentions a separate project called 'Tadam' at the end without explanation. Notes that the item Description field is not populated by default due to rss-parser setup, and automatic pull requires an Obsidian restart to take effect.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to collect RSS feed articles as notes in the vault.
summary: RSS reader that pulls feed items into your vault as notes, with Mustache templates and custom feed types.
